_comment: Transcribed from assets/projects/*.md, with categories from the supplied projects.md. Two deliberate departures from that file: (1) Misr El-Kheir and YaFleet are featured because they are the only two whose case studies verify authorship, while the four it marked featured all state attribution could not be verified; (2) YaFleet's category is Logistics, not Fleet Management — its case study documents a peer-to-peer luggage-space marketplace. Adding a project: add an entry here, create the detail_file, and declare assets/projects/<slug>/ in pubspec.yaml — folder declarations are NOT recursive.
